items.title_zh: 菲尔兹奖得主梅纳德谈“AI 攻克黎曼猜想”：相信证明正确，但成果被人理解、才可能得到认可
items.title_en: Fields Medalist Maynard on 'AI Cracking the Riemann Hypothesis': He Believes the Proof Is Correct, but Acceptance Requires Human Understanding
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 22 日消息，当地时间 11 月 20 日，Anthropic 数学家莱文特 · 阿尔珀格（Levent Alpöge）宣布，自己与 AI 模型 Claude 合作，攻克了数学界最著名的难题之一 —— 黎曼猜想。 据IT之家此前报道，11 月 21 日，Lean 与 Mathlib 社区发布联合声明，以 Lean 库形式给出的黎曼猜想证明已经通过核验，该证明的代码约 1700 万行。 据每日经济新闻报道，2022 年菲尔兹奖得主、牛津大学数学教授詹姆斯 · 梅纳德（James Maynard）接受采访时表示，他认为这项证明是正确的，但强调“理解一个定理为什么成立，远比仅仅证明它成立重要”。 只有当有人真正理解这项成果，并能够向其他人解释清楚时，这份证明才有可能得到数学界的全面认可 。 梅纳德是当代解析数论领域的重要数学家，长期致力于素数分布等数学问题的研究。2022 年，他凭借相关研究成果获得菲尔兹奖。 由于这项结果已经获得形式化验证，而且这一验证又经过了独立核实。此外，阿尔珀格过去在提出此类重大主张方面有着可靠的记录。综合这两点，梅纳德称非常有信心认为这一结果是正确的。 梅纳德表示，虽然黎曼猜想确实有一些直接的数学推论，但这个问题之所以被认为如此重要，主要是因为人们一直期待，要解释素数分布中这种深刻的内在结构， 就必须发展出新的数学理论 。 在我们真正理解证明中的思想和整体框架之前，这项成果很可能无法带来人们所期待的变革。 不过，我相信随着时间推移，我们最终会真正理解这份证明，而这必将彻底改变我们对相关数学问题的认识。 相关阅读： 《 AI 攻克黎曼猜想？Anthropic 数学家宣称已与 Claude 合作完成证明 》 《 Anthropic 数学家 AI 攻克黎曼猜想？Lean 社区通过核验，数十人报告代码库编译正确 》
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 22: On Nov 20 local time, Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge announced that he had worked with the AI model Claude to crack one of mathematics' most famous problems, the Riemann Hypothesis. On Nov 21, the Lean and Mathlib community issued a joint statement saying a Riemann Hypothesis proof given in the form of a Lean library had passed verification, with roughly 17 million lines of code. According to National Business Daily, James Maynard, a 2022 Fields Medalist and mathematics professor at Oxford, said in an interview that he believes the proof is correct but stressed that "understanding why a theorem holds is far more important than merely proving that it holds"; only when someone truly understands the result and can explain it clearly to others can the proof gain the full recognition of the mathematics community. Maynard is a leading contemporary analytic number theorist who has long worked on problems such as the distribution of primes, and won the Fields Medal in 2022 for related research. He said that because the result has been formally verified and that verification has in turn been independently checked, and because Alpöge has a reliable record of making such major claims in the past, he is highly confident the result is correct. Maynard said that although the Riemann Hypothesis has some direct mathematical corollaries, the problem is considered so important mainly because people have long expected that explaining this deep internal structure in the distribution of primes would require developing new mathematical theory; before the ideas and overall framework of the proof are truly understood, the result is likely unable to bring the changes people expect. He believes, however, that over time people will eventually truly understand the proof, and that this will fundamentally change understanding of the relevant mathematical problems.
items.why_zh: 若报道属实，这显示“形式化验证通过”与数学界“理解并接受”之间仍有距离，AI 数学成果的认可机制或成为新议题（推测）。
items.why_en: If the report is accurate, it suggests a gap remains between passing formal verification and the mathematics community understanding and accepting a result, and how AI-produced mathematics gains recognition may become a new issue (speculative).

items.title_zh: 《以撒的结合：忏悔 +》最新“罪恶城”更新引争议，玩家称游戏音乐系 AI 工具生成
items.title_en: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ 'Vice City' Update Sparks Backlash Over Alleged AI-Generated Music
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 22 日消息，据外媒 kotaku 报道，《以撒的结合：忏悔 +（The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+）》最新的“罪恶城”免费更新疑似使用了 AI 生成的背景音乐，引发 Steam 玩家集中差评。 具体来看，本次更新主要是为了致敬《GTA6》，玩家在更新游戏后只需在开始挑战前输入代码“V1CE BSMT”，就能进入一个以罪恶城为主题的特别版本，其中包含专属武器和背景音乐。 然而，有玩家发现该特别模式中的音乐疑似由 AI 音乐生成工具 Suno 制作，相应音频文件保留了 Suno 生成工具的元数据，玩家可以通过 VLC 等工具查看文件注释信息，例如名为 drivingsong1.ogg 的文件就包含以下记录： comment: made with suno; created=2026-10-30T17:53:41Z; id= cd5a5b55-bead-4cb9-949d-09ed1f917dce 这一发现迅速引发玩家不满。有玩家在《以撒的结合》Reddit 社区发帖质疑，开发团队使用 AI 生成音乐相当敷衍，不如不推出更新。 目前，游戏已临时更新移除了 AI 生成的音乐，不过截至报道发布时，游戏创作者 Edmund McMillen 和发行商兼联合开发商 Nicalis 尚未就使用 AI 音乐一事正式承担责任，也没有解释这些内容究竟是如何进入游戏。
items.summary_en: According to foreign outlet Kotaku, the latest free "Vice City" update for The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ appears to use AI-generated background music, drawing a wave of negative Steam reviews. The update is mainly a tribute to GTA6: players enter the code "V1CE BSMT" before starting a challenge to access a Vice City-themed special version with exclusive weapons and background music. However, players found that the music in that mode appears to have been made with the AI music generation tool Suno, as the audio files retain Suno metadata that can be viewed with tools such as VLC; a file named drivingsong1.ogg, for example, contains the record: comment: made with suno; created=2026-10-30T17:53:41Z; id=cd5a5b55-bead-4cb9-949d-09ed1f917dce. The discovery quickly triggered player dissatisfaction, with users posting in the game's Reddit community questioning that using AI-generated music was perfunctory and that the update would have been better left unreleased. The game has since been temporarily updated to remove the AI-generated music, but as of publication, creator Edmund McMillen and publisher/co-developer Nicalis had not formally taken responsibility for the use of AI music or explained how the content entered the game.
items.why_zh: 推测：玩家通过音频文件元数据直接举证，可能加剧游戏行业对生成式 AI 素材使用与披露的审视。
items.why_en: Speculation: players pointing directly to audio-file metadata as evidence could intensify scrutiny of how generative AI assets are used and disclosed in the games industry.

items.title_zh: 前英特尔 CEO 基辛格：随着 AI 需要“一万倍的效率飞跃”，渐进式芯片性能提升无法满足
items.title_en: Former Intel CEO Gelsinger: AI needs a "10,000x efficiency leap," incremental chip gains won't suffice
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，据 Wccftech 报道，前英特尔首席执行官帕特 · 基辛格（Pat Gelsinger）表示，随着人工智能需要“ 10,000 倍的效率飞跃 ”，渐进式的芯片增益将无法满足需求，他同时否认了摩尔定律已走向终结。 在 2026 年 COSM 科技峰会上，帕特 · 基辛格出席了一场题为“现实检验：超越芯片（Reality Check: Beyond Chips）”的炉边谈话。 基辛格在谈话中反驳了半导体微缩已触及物理极限的观点， 他认为 AI 需要的不是常规的代际升级，而是计算效率实现激进的 10,000 倍跃升 。他还指出，摩尔定律（Moore’s Law）能否重焕生机，取决于五大核心工程领域（IT之家注：光学、供电、散热、材料和封装）的根本性突破。 峰会结束后，帕特 · 基辛格在 X 上写道：“ 摩尔定律已死？我说现在是唤醒它的时候了 ！”尽管一些行业观察人士可能会认为传统的摩尔定律微缩已经结束，但基辛格坚持认为半导体工程正在进入一个多学科创新的新时代，他表示：“在半导体行业工作 40 多年后，我相信我们最伟大的创新仍在前方！” 自 2025 年 3 月以普通合伙人身份加入风险投资机构 Playground Global 以来，基辛格一直在积极支持针对这些硬件瓶颈的初创企业，其中包括获得美国政府支持的光刻初创企业 xLight（该公司目标突破阿斯麦 ASML 的 13.5 纳米极紫外 EUV 波长壁垒），以及核能产能公司 Alva Energy。 除了光刻与发电领域，基辛格的技术路线图还瞄准了光互连与硅光子技术，旨在用光信号替代传统的铜线来传输数据。 相关阅读： 《 前英特尔 CEO 基辛格称 HBM 是“糟糕的内存” 》 《 前英特尔 CEO 基辛格押注新 AI 内存：Z2RAM 拟绕开 EUV 光刻，4 年内送样 》
items.summary_en: According to Wccftech, former Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger said that with AI requiring a "10,000x efficiency leap," incremental chip gains will not be enough, while rejecting the idea that Moore's Law is over. At the 2026 COSM technology summit, Gelsinger took part in a fireside chat titled "Reality Check: Beyond Chips." He pushed back on the view that semiconductor scaling has hit physical limits, arguing that AI needs not routine generational upgrades but a radical 10,000x jump in computing efficiency. He also said whether Moore's Law can be revived depends on fundamental breakthroughs in five core engineering areas: optics, power delivery, thermal management, materials and packaging. After the summit, Gelsinger wrote on X: "Moore's Law is dead? I say it's time to wake it up!" While some industry observers may believe traditional Moore's Law scaling has ended, Gelsinger insists semiconductor engineering is entering a new era of multidisciplinary innovation, saying: "After more than 40 years in the semiconductor industry, I believe our greatest innovations are still ahead of us!" Since joining venture firm Playground Global as a general partner in March 2025, Gelsinger has actively backed startups targeting these hardware bottlenecks, including US-government-backed lithography startup xLight, which aims to break ASML's 13.5-nanometer extreme ultraviolet (EUV) wavelength barrier, and nuclear capacity company Alva Energy. Beyond lithography and power generation, Gelsinger's roadmap also targets optical interconnect and silicon photonics, aiming to replace traditional copper wiring with optical signals for data transmission.
items.why_zh: 推测：这反映前沿AI算力瓶颈正把讨论从单纯制程微缩推向材料、封装、供电与光互连等多学科工程，但属个人判断而非行业共识。
items.why_en: Speculative: this reflects how frontier AI compute bottlenecks are pushing debate beyond pure process scaling toward multidisciplinary engineering in materials, packaging, power and optical interconnect, but it is one person's view rather than an industry consensus.

items.title_zh: 蚂蚁集团 CEO 韩歆毅：人工智能已走到临床很多环节，相信 AI 可以成为连接医患延续照顾的可靠纽带
items.title_en: Ant Group CEO Han Xinyi: AI Has Reached Many Clinical Stages and Can Become a Reliable Link Connecting Doctors and Patients
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 22 日消息，据新浪科技今天报道，蚂蚁集团 CEO 韩歆毅今日在 2026 蚂蚁阿福医疗健康生态大会表示， AI 这几年已经走到了临床的很多环节 。 韩歆毅表示：“我们看到从门诊到病房，从随访到科研，其实需要思考一个根本的命题，当 AI 走进了医院，走进了患者的日常生活，到底应该怎样服务医学、服务医生、服务患者。” 这名 CEO 认为，蚂蚁阿福的初心是希望从临床的真实需求出发，帮助医生更好前进，让青年医生更好的成长，让医院也更好地组织医疗服务。 他相信 AI 可以成为连接医患延续照顾的可靠纽带 。 IT之家查询蚂蚁集团官网发现，韩歆毅 2014 年 5 月加入蚂蚁集团，历任资深总监、副总裁、首席财务官。2024 年 3 月，韩歆毅出任蚂蚁集团总裁，2025 年 3 月，出任蚂蚁集团首席执行官。 ▲ 图源：蚂蚁集团 加入蚂蚁集团之前，韩歆毅于 2011 年 9 月加入阿里巴巴集团，担任阿里巴巴集团企业融资部资深总监。在此之前，韩歆毅 2001 年 7 月至 2011 年 9 月任职于中国国际金融有限公司投资银行部。韩歆毅分别于 1999 年 7 月及 2001 年 6 月获得清华大学经济学学士学位和经济学硕士学位。
items.summary_en: According to Sina Tech, Ant Group CEO Han Xinyi said at the 2026 Ant A-Fu Healthcare Ecosystem Conference that AI has over the past few years reached many stages of clinical work. Han said: "From outpatient clinics to wards, from follow-up to research, we need to consider a fundamental question: as AI enters hospitals and patients' daily lives, how should it serve medicine, doctors and patients?" He said Ant A-Fu's original intent is to start from real clinical needs, help doctors move forward, help young doctors grow and help hospitals better organize medical services, and he believes AI can become a reliable link connecting doctors and patients and continuing care. According to Ant Group's official website, Han joined Ant Group in May 2014 and has served as senior director, vice president and chief financial officer; he became president of Ant Group in March 2024 and CEO in March 2025. Before joining Ant Group, he joined Alibaba Group in September 2011 as senior director of its corporate finance department, and worked at China International Capital Corporation's investment banking department from July 2001 to September 2011. He received a bachelor's degree in economics from Tsinghua University in July 1999 and a master's degree in economics in June 2001.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 22 日消息，据《卫报》今天报道，德国军工初创企业 Helsing 近期在柏林艺术中心 Kraftwerk Berlin 举办 AI 目标识别系统 Clarity 发布活动，引发当地乐迷、电音社区强烈抗议。 据报道，Kraftwerk Berlin 是一座位于柏林的巨型后工业艺术与音乐文化空间，以粗粝的混凝土建筑和实验电子音乐、装置艺术闻名。这里不仅是实验音乐节 Atonal 的举办地，也与电音俱乐部 Tresor 处于同一个园区。 然而在上周（IT之家注：当地时间 11 月 11 日），这家前卫的场馆被改造成“作战室”。据到场者描述，混凝土墙壁上投射着地图和航拍画面，天花板上悬挂着无人机，身穿防弹衣的保安则带着搜爆犬在场地内巡逻。 Helsing 的 Clarity 系统是由 AI 智能体驱动的情报平台，能够利用无人机、卫星和传感器收集的数据锁定目标，最终打击行动仍由人类负责审批。 目前军事软件领域的市场领导者，是美国 Palantir 公司开发的 Maven 系统。欧洲各国政府一直在积极寻找本土替代方案，法国情报机构已宣布放弃 Palantir，转而使用本土情报系统。 然而欧洲各国对军工产业的扶持 ， 与社会长期形成的反军事文化形成冲突 。例如在柏林，人们在冷战时期常常前往夜店跳舞，来摆脱军备竞赛焦虑。 柏林音乐策展人兼 DJ Michail Stangl 表示：“我们已经看到，AI 驱动的目标锁定系统应用在战场。很难想象，如果 Helsing 成功开发出军用系统，他们真的不会将其出售给政府、警察，或者欧洲边境和海岸警卫局这样的机构，用于对付移民？” 电音俱乐部 Tresor 对此事表示强烈谴责，称这样的活动不应该出现在他们社区内。 Helsing 发言人对此回应称，他们的军事系统不以识别个人为设计目标，Clarity 的用途是寻找雷达系统、导弹发射阵地和舰船等物体。 面对舆论压力，Kraftwerk Berlin 艺术中心承认此次场地出租是一次「严重的判断失误」， 并承诺调整商业租赁部门的预订政策 。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 22: according to a report by The Guardian today, German defense startup Helsing recently held a launch event at the Berlin art center Kraftwerk Berlin for its AI target-recognition system Clarity, triggering strong protests from local music fans and the electronic music community. According to the report, Kraftwerk Berlin is a huge post-industrial art and music cultural space in Berlin, known for its raw concrete architecture and experimental electronic music and installation art. It hosts the experimental music festival Atonal and is in the same complex as the techno club Tresor. However, last week (IT Home note: local time Nov 11), this avant-garde venue was turned into a "war room." According to attendees, maps and aerial footage were projected onto the concrete walls, drones hung from the ceiling, and security guards in body armor patrolled the venue with explosive-detection dogs. Helsing's Clarity system is an intelligence platform driven by AI agents that can use data collected by drones, satellites and sensors to lock onto targets, with final strike actions still subject to human approval. The current market leader in military software is the Maven system developed by US company Palantir. European governments have been actively seeking local alternatives; France's intelligence agency has announced it is dropping Palantir in favor of a domestic intelligence system. However, European governments' support for the defense industry conflicts with the anti-military culture long formed in society. In Berlin, for example, during the Cold War people often went to nightclubs to dance away anxiety about the arms race. Berlin music curator and DJ Michail Stangl said: "We've already seen AI-driven targeting systems used on the battlefield. It's hard to imagine that if Helsing successfully develops military systems, they really won't sell them to governments, police, or agencies like the European Border and Coast Guard to use against migrants?" The techno club Tresor strongly condemned the event, saying such an event should not appear in their community. A Helsing spokesperson responded that their military systems are not designed to identify individuals, and that Clarity is meant to find objects such as radar systems, missile launch sites and ships. Under public pressure, Kraftwerk Berlin acknowledged that renting out the venue was a "serious error of judgment" and promised to adjust the booking policies of its commercial rentals department.

items.title_en: Anthropic Mathematician's AI Said to Crack Riemann Hypothesis? Lean Community Passes Verification; Dozens Report Codebase Compiles Correctly
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 22 日消息，11 月 21 日，Lean 与 Mathlib 社区发布联合声明，称莱文特・阿尔波格（Levent Alpöge）以 Lean 库形式给出的黎曼猜想证明已经通过核验， 该证明的代码约 1700 万行 。（IT 之家注：Lean 是交互式定理证明器，可逐行机械核验数学推理是否符合逻辑公理。） 声明由 Lean 与 Mathlib 社区联合发布，并获 Lean FRO 与 Mathlib Initiative 背书。声明称，阿尔波格的库仅直接依赖 Mathlib；过去一天内，Lean 与 Mathlib 社区已参与验证。 声明列出四项核验标准，并称这几项标准均已满足： 陈述正确： 证明所用的陈述来自 Mathlib 的 RiemannHypothesis，已由 Lean 与数论专家审核； 代码可编译： 数十人报告编译通过，并复现出相同的原始证明导出文件； 证明对应正确陈述： 社区新增一个仅导入 Mathlib 的文件以隔离该陈述，再用 comparator 和 con-leche --compare 两套独立工具比对，确认库中证明的定理与 Mathlib 的陈述完全一致； 证明有效： 原始导出文件经多个证明检查器检验，包括 Lean 官方内核、con-leche、con-ron，以及第三方以不同编程语言实现的检查器。 声明特别提到，con-leche 与 con-ron 附带相对集合论的形式化证明，因此可以保证它们不会接受错误证明，这也回应了“Lean 逻辑本身可能存在漏洞”的担忧。上述检查在惰性导出文件上运行，不受源码中潜在恶意代码影响。 声明最后称，感谢为验证提供资源的社区成员，并期待数学界后续工作解释该证明中的新思路。 IT之家注： 黎曼猜想由德国数学家伯恩哈德 · 黎曼于 1859 年提出 ，认为看似随机分布在数轴上的质数，实际上遵循着复杂而有意义的规律。此后，黎曼猜想成为整个数论研究领域的重要指引，也是数学界最著名的未解难题。 IT之家附声明原文及译文： Lean verification of the Riemann Hypothesis Joint statement by the Lean and Mathlib communities, endorsed by the Lean FRO and the Mathlib Initiative. On November 20, 2026, Levent Alpöge released a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis as a Lean library comprising 17 million lines of code. We have full confidence that Alpöge's proof of the Riemann Hypothesis is correct, and we congratulate him on this achievement. Our rationale is outlined below. The codebase depends directly only on Mathlib. Over the past day, the Lean and Mathlib communities have rallied to verify the proof's correctness. We hereby certify that both the statement and the proof of the Riemann Hypothesis are correct. The four criteria in https://xenaproject.wordpress.com/2026/11/12/and-the-proof-is-checked-in-lean/ are all satisfied. The statement of the Riemann Hypothesis is correct. This statement is part of Mathlib: RiemannHypothesis and has been carefully vett…
items.summary_en: IT Home reported on Nov 22 that on Nov 21 the Lean and Mathlib communities issued a joint statement saying Levent Alpöge's Lean-library proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, comprising about 17 million lines of code, had passed verification; the statement was issued by the Lean and Mathlib communities and endorsed by the Lean FRO and the Mathlib Initiative. The statement lists four verification criteria and says all were met: the statement is correct—it comes from Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis and was reviewed by Lean and number-theory experts; the code compiles—dozens reported successful compilation and reproduced the same original proof export file; the proof corresponds to the correct statement—the community added a file importing only Mathlib to isolate the statement and used two independent tools, comparator and con-leche --compare, to confirm the theorem proved in the library exactly matches Mathlib's statement; the proof is valid—the original export file was checked by multiple proof checkers, including the official Lean kernel, con-leche, con-ron, and third-party checkers implemented in different programming languages. The statement says con-leche and con-ron come with formal proofs relative to set theory, so they can be guaranteed not to accept incorrect proofs; the checks were run on lazy export files and are not affected by potentially malicious code in the source. The statement thanks community members who provided resources for verification and looks forward to follow-up work by the mathematics community explaining the new ideas in the proof. The attached original statement says Alpöge released the proof on Nov 20, 2026. IT Home notes that the Riemann Hypothesis was proposed by Bernhard Riemann in 1859 and is an important guide in number theory and one of mathematics' most famous unsolved problems.
items.why_zh: 若核验成立，这将是数学与形式化验证领域的重大事件；但该说法来自社区声明与二手报道，仍需独立数学界审视（推测）。
items.why_en: If the verification holds, it would be a major moment for mathematics and formal verification; however, the claim comes from a community statement and secondary reporting and still needs independent scrutiny by mathematicians (speculative).

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 22 日消息，11 月 21 日晚，国家中医药管理局中医师资格认证中心通过官方公众号发布声明称，该中心从未公开历年真题，未与任何大模型企业合作，亦未开展测评。 声明称，近期部分人工智能大模型产品及其运营、推广主体宣称其 大模型经过了中医类别医师资格考试试题测试 等事宜。 声明称，中心从未以任何形式向社会公开、发布或出售中医类别医师资格考试历年试题（含真题、原题）、参考答案及相关考试资料，亦未授权任何单位或个人公开、发布、销售。市场上以“历年真题”“官方真题”“内部题库”“原题还原”等名义提供、销售或 用于训练、测评人工智能大模型的内容 ，均非中心提供。 声明还称， 中心从未与任何人工智能大模型企业、平台或相关机构建立合作关系 ；未授权任何主体使用中心名称、简称、标识、考试数据及考试资料用于大模型训练、产品宣传或者商业推广；中心未对任何大模型产品开展过测评、认证、认可或者推荐。 声明表示，任何单位或者个人应立即停止不当宣传，删除、下架相关信息与内容，中心保留依法追究其法律责任的一切权利。 IT之家从公开资料获悉，国家中医药管理局中医师资格认证中心，2000 年 12 月 19 日，经中华人民共和国中央编制委员会办公室批准，成立了国家中医药管理局中医师资格认证中心。2007 年经批准增加组织实施中医药行业特有工种职业技能鉴定工作职能，并加挂国家中医药管理局职业技能鉴定指导中心牌子。2022 年中编办批准中心机构职能和编制调整。 该中心承担中医药行业相关考试和人才评价，以及有关考试质量评估、科学研究与交流、信息化建设等工作，中医药行业职业技能鉴定的有关指导工作。
items.summary_en: On the evening of Nov 21, the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine TCM Physician Qualification Certification Center said in a statement via its official WeChat account that it has never publicly released past exam questions, has not cooperated with any large-model company, and has not conducted evaluations. The statement said the center has never in any form publicized, released or sold past TCM physician qualification exam questions (including real questions and original questions), reference answers or related exam materials, nor authorized any unit or individual to publicize, release or sell them; content offered or sold on the market under names such as “past exam questions,” “official exam questions,” “internal question bank” or “original question restoration,” or used for training or evaluating AI large models, is not provided by the center. It also said the center has never established cooperative relations with any AI large-model company, platform or related institution; has not authorized any entity to use its name, abbreviation, logo, exam data or exam materials for large-model training, product promotion or commercial promotion; and has not evaluated, certified, recognized or recommended any large-model product. The center said any unit or individual should immediately stop improper promotion and delete or take down related information and content, and it reserves all rights to pursue legal liability. Public information shows the center was established on Dec 19, 2000 with approval from the Central Institutional Organization Commission Office; in 2007 it added the function of organizing vocational skill appraisal for special TCM industry jobs; in 2022 its functions and staffing were adjusted; it undertakes TCM industry exams and talent evaluation, exam quality assessment, scientific research and exchange, informatization, and guidance for vocational skill appraisal.

items.summary_en: The “IT Morning Brief” is dated Sunday, Nov 22, 2026. Key items include: 1. Blogger @数码闲聊站 said that besides Huawei, other vendors are also considering adding a “wide form” to their main flagship lines, running in parallel with regular bar phones; 2. Anthropic technical team member Tao Lin, in a Nov 15 interview with Palisade Research, predicted that by the end of 2027, AI may match or surpass the world's top human experts in almost all fields including programming and filmmaking; 3. Huawei Xingmang O1 Pro's starting price of 5,499 yuan sparked controversy; Xingmang General Manager Liu He responded “we choose innovation first,” the 16GB version sold out across platforms on its first day, and Xingmang will later expand to all-scenario categories; 4. Microsoft AI and agent product director Howard Crow responded to Microsoft To Do's shutdown next year and promised to help users transition smoothly; 5. OpenAI reported anti-distillation protection progress: in black-box red-team tests, GPT-6.2 Astra chain-of-thought extraction success rate fell from 54% to 0.2%, and for new requests from 22.9% to 0.9%; it bans thousands to tens of thousands of accounts weekly for unauthorized distillation; 6. Business Insider reported that Anthropic, through a special equity design, gives seven co-founders including CEO Dario Amodei joint control of 50.1% of shareholder voting rights; 7. BYD Denza B5 towed a 180-ton Boeing 747-400 more than 1.6 km in overseas tests, with three tests keeping four wheels, running on three wheels with added ballast, and removing the right-side two wheels with ballast increased to 5 tons; 8. A South African developer claims to have single-handedly developed Impossible OS, aiming to natively run Win32 API software while compatible with Linux binaries, with results expected in two years; 9. FAW Audi announced that the Audi Q9 will make its China debut at the 2026 Guangzhou International Automobile Exhibition opening Nov 27; 10. Reports say Huawei Mate 90 Air uses a Kirin 9020 chip, is 6.58mm thick, and will launch on Nov 24 at 14:30; 11. Windows Central said GTA 6 preorders exceeded 24 million, but one physical game store sold only five copies; 12. Reports say Huawei's Xingmang brand has been incubated internally for about three years, will not be given overly high sales or operating targets in the next one or two years, and will take on earlier application of more frontier technologies.

items.title_zh: 加密聊天应用 Signal 默认屏蔽截图，防止 AI 智能体读取用户消息
items.title_en: Encrypted chat app Signal blocks screenshots by default to prevent AI agents from reading user messages
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 22 日消息，开源端到端加密聊天应用 Signal 近日推出 iOS / Android 版更新，默认关闭应用程序内截图功能，以阻止 Siri AI 和 Gemini 等 AI 智能体读取用户私人消息。 Signal 总裁 Meredith Whittaker 表示，系统级 AI 智能体的影响力正不断扩大，这对 Signal 长期建立的隐私机制构成威胁，因为这些智能体可能在用户毫不知情的情况下访问私人对话。 在 Signal 8.37（IT之家注：iOS 27 系统）中， 应用默认启用了“阻止 Siri AI”设置 ，用户无法在 Signal 内截图或录屏。用户可选择关闭该功能 10 分钟，或是直接永久禁用。 来到安卓这边，Signal 8.35.1 或更高版本检测到 AI 助手试图截图读取消息时，会自动启用“屏幕安全”策略阻止截屏。不过官方表示，由于不同安卓设备的实现方式存在差异，这项检测功能并不能在所有设备上稳定运行。 此外 Signal 表示，由于缺少必要开发工具，macOS 版 Signal 无法实现类似的防止截图功能。官方建议用户在系统设置中，将 Signal 放入“Siri 排除列表”中。
items.summary_en: The open-source end-to-end encrypted chat app Signal recently released iOS/Android updates that disable in-app screenshots by default, to stop AI agents such as Siri AI and Gemini from reading users' private messages. Signal President Meredith Whittaker said system-level AI agents are growing in influence and threaten Signal's long-standing privacy mechanisms, because such agents may access private conversations without users' knowledge. In Signal 8.37 (iOS 27), the app enables a “Block Siri AI” setting by default, so users cannot take screenshots or record the screen inside Signal; users can disable it for 10 minutes or permanently. On Android, Signal 8.35.1 or later automatically enables a “screen security” policy to block screenshots when it detects an AI assistant trying to capture messages to read them. However, the company said that because Android device implementations differ, this detection does not work reliably on all devices. Signal also said the macOS version cannot implement similar screenshot prevention due to a lack of necessary development tools, and recommends that users add Signal to the “Siri exclusion list” in system settings.
items.why_zh: 推测：这反映端侧 AI 智能体权限扩张与加密通信隐私保护之间的冲突。
items.why_en: Speculative: this reflects tension between expanding on-device AI agent permissions and privacy protection in encrypted communications.

items.title_zh: 马斯克预警：AI 行业明年可能面临严重资金短缺，或需要数千亿美元额外投入
items.title_en: Musk Warns AI Industry May Face Severe Funding Shortage Next Year, Potentially Requiring Hundreds of Billions in Extra Investment
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 22 日消息，深度学习领域开源项目 Keras 创始人弗朗索瓦・肖莱（François Chollet）在 X 上发文称，要么你认为 AI 基础设施建设已经结束，AI 只是一场昙花一现的泡沫，且算力需求已经见顶；要么，这就是一次难得的买入机会。 弗朗索瓦称，GPU 现货价格仍在上涨，产能难以保障，HBM 和 DRAM 到 2029 年的产能基本已被订满，芯片和存储供应预计将持续紧张，一直延续到 2030 年代。前沿模型的训练算力约每 5 个月翻一番，模型能力提升速度是推理模型出现前的两倍以上。AI 推理业务的利润率可达 70% 至 85%，需求仍在快速增长，每一代新模型都会带来新的应用场景。 IT之家注意到，马斯克回复弗朗索瓦称，让如此大规模的算力设备通电、冷却并实现稳定运行，极其困难。 （人工智能行业） 明年可能面临严重的资金短缺 。如果全行业从支付算力成本到设备能够稳定创收的时间累计推迟数月， 仅营运资金就可能需要额外投入数千亿美元 ， 这些钱从哪里来 ？
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 22: François Chollet, founder of the deep-learning open-source project Keras, posted on X that either you believe AI infrastructure buildout is over and AI is a passing bubble with compute demand having peaked, or this is a rare buying opportunity. Chollet said GPU spot prices are still rising, capacity is hard to secure, HBM and DRAM output through 2029 is essentially fully booked, and chip and memory supply is expected to remain tight into the 2030s; training compute for frontier models is roughly doubling every five months, with capabilities improving more than twice as fast as before reasoning models emerged; AI inference margins can reach 70% to 85%, demand is still growing rapidly, and each new model generation brings new use cases. IT Home noted that Musk replied to Chollet that powering, cooling and keeping such large-scale compute equipment running stably is extremely difficult, and that the AI industry may face a severe funding shortage next year. If, across the industry, the time from paying compute costs to equipment reliably generating revenue is cumulatively delayed by several months, working capital alone could require hundreds of billions of dollars in additional investment — and where would that money come from?
items.why_zh: 此为马斯克个人表态而非行业数据，但若算力投入与创收时间的错配属实，AI 基础设施投资的风险或被重新定价（推测）。
items.why_en: This is Musk's personal remark rather than industry data, but if the mismatch between compute spending and the timing of revenue is real, the risk of AI infrastructure investment could be repriced (speculative).

items.title_en: Tencent Chatterfly Keyboard Android Beta Opens, Supports Voice Transcription, Automatic Translation and Other AI Features
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 22 日消息， 腾讯 Chatterfly 输入法安卓版现已开启内测 ，iOS 版目前状态为“即将发布”。 据介绍，Chatterfly 输入法除了将语音变成文字外，还能理解上下文，识别不同的意图和场景，还能听懂用户的需求，帮用户执行任务。 IT之家附该输入法主要特性如下： 语音输入，说完即成稿：不用组织语言，Chatterfly 能自动识别语境，帮你理成清楚、得体的话； 说完自动翻译：翻译模式支持一键唤起，将语音直接翻译为指定语言，让交流如母语般自然； 全场景 AI 打字，打字更顺心：超强意图理解能力，超全词库品类，持续学习你的打字习惯，输入更省心； 表达 Skill，场景化深度润色：工作汇报、会议纪要、AI 提示词、营销文案… 启用 Skill，AI 自动识别场景，深度润色加工； AI 指令，快速执行任务：文本创作、即时翻译、信息提炼…… 只需按下快捷键，说话就能下达指令，让 Chatterfly 直接输出结果。 参考： https://chatterfly.tencent.com/
items.summary_en: IT Home reported on Nov 22 that the Android version of Tencent's Chatterfly keyboard has opened beta testing, while the iOS version is listed as coming soon. According to the description, besides turning speech into text, the keyboard can understand context, identify different intents and scenarios, and help users execute tasks. Main features include: voice input that turns speech into a draft, automatically recognizing context and organizing it into clear, appropriate wording; automatic translation after speaking, with a translation mode invoked by one click to translate speech directly into a specified language; all-scenario AI typing with intent understanding and a broad vocabulary, continuously learning the user's typing habits; Expression Skills for deep, scenario-based polishing in work reports, meeting minutes, AI prompts, marketing copy and other scenarios; and AI commands that let users press a shortcut and speak to issue tasks such as text creation, instant translation and information extraction, with Chatterfly directly outputting the result. Reference: chatterfly.tencent.com.
items.why_zh: 输入法正成为 AI 助手入口；内测阶段功能与实际效果仍需用户验证（推测）。
items.why_en: It suggests keyboards are becoming an entry point for AI assistants; the features' real-world performance remains to be tested in beta (speculative).

items.title_zh: 美参议员痛批苹果、谷歌：放任 AI 脱衣应用“野蛮生长”
items.title_en: US senators criticize Apple and Google for allowing AI "nudify" apps
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，据英国《卫报》报道，美国参议员罗恩 · 怀登、埃德 · 马基和本 · 卢汉指出，苹果和谷歌未能有效识别或下架用于生成未经当事人同意的裸照或色情图像的应用。 三人还指出，Meta 仍在从这些所谓的 AI 脱衣应用广告中获利。 当地时间 18 日，三人向苹果、谷歌和 Meta 的 CEO 致函，指出各公司现有的防护措施 不足以阻止 AI 脱衣应用出现在各自的应用商店或平台上 。 研究发现，苹果、谷歌和 Meta 的政策均禁止此类应用，它们却仍然出现在苹果和谷歌应用商店中，或通过 Meta 平台上的广告推广。研究还发现，儿童依然能够轻易接触到这些应用。 来自俄勒冈州的参议员怀登指出，如果这些公司不加强打击那些专门为造成伤害而设计并推广的应用，国会就需要采取行动。“AI 大幅提升了制作和传播未经当事人同意的色情影像的能力，给女性和女孩造成了巨大伤害。大型科技公司没有增加应对这一挑战的投入，反而在削减负责保护用户免受伤害的团队。我希望弄清楚，为什么 Meta、苹果和谷歌会漏掉那些明显违反自身规则的行为。” 谷歌发言人卡尔 · 瑞安在声明中回应称：“Google Play 不允许含有色情内容或允许用户对他人图像进行 AI 脱衣处理的应用上架。我们一直主动采取措施，检测并下架含有有害内容的应用。” Meta 发言人安迪 · 斯通在声明中回应称：“我们禁止传播儿童性虐待材料（CSAM），也禁止推广 AI 脱衣应用，并积极采取措施，防止此类内容出现在我们的平台上。…… 我们已经采取多项措施打击这些行为，包括封禁、对其他广告商采取法律行动、打击协同行动网络，以及 删除 9200 万条色情广告 。我们也在积极探索进一步改进检测能力的方法。” 苹果发言人彼得 · 阿杰米安表示，TTP 的报告并未反映苹果现行的软件及安全功能。苹果新增的保护措施包括加强对青少年的保护，以及在“屏幕使用时间”中扩展家长控制功能，让家庭能够阻止儿童和青少年下载年龄分级超出其年龄范围的应用。 IT之家从报道中获悉，参议员们在信中指出，过去两年， 未经当事人同意而由 AI 生成的裸照数量有所增加 。这一趋势也在多项调查得到印证。联合国儿童基金会在 2026 年初发布的报告显示，11 个国家至少有 120 万名儿童报告称，自己曾遭遇未经本人同意的裸照侵害。 10 月，TTP 研究人员就他们在苹果 App Store 发现的 AI 脱衣应用联系苹果后，苹果对自身政策作出了进一步说明。谷歌此前向《卫报》表示，公司会主动检测并下架含有有害内容的应用。Meta 则推出了新的 AI 工具，专门用于识别和删除含有 CSAM 的广告。 参议员们在信中写道，这些发现表明，苹果和谷歌不仅没有下架助长私密影像侵害的应用，还可能从这些应用的分发过程中获利。
items.summary_en: According to The Guardian, US Senators Ron Wyden, Ed Markey and Ben Luján said Apple and Google have failed to effectively identify or remove apps used to generate non-consensual nude or sexual images, and that Meta is still profiting from ads for so-called AI nudify apps. On the 18th local time, the three sent letters to the CEOs of Apple, Google and Meta, saying the companies' existing safeguards are insufficient to keep AI nudify apps off their app stores or platforms. Research found that all three companies' policies prohibit such apps, yet they still appear in Apple's and Google's app stores or are promoted through ads on Meta's platforms, and that children can still easily access them. Senator Wyden of Oregon said that if the companies do not crack down harder on apps designed and promoted to cause harm, Congress will need to act, adding: "AI has dramatically increased the ability to create and spread non-consensual sexual imagery, causing enormous harm to women and girls. Instead of increasing investment to meet this challenge, Big Tech companies are cutting teams responsible for protecting users from harm. I want to understand why Meta, Apple and Google are missing conduct that clearly violates their own rules." Google spokesperson Karl Ryan said in a statement that "Google Play does not allow apps that contain sexual content or that allow users to AI-undress images of others. We take proactive steps to detect and remove apps with harmful content." Meta spokesperson Andy Stone said: "We prohibit the dissemination of child sexual abuse material (CSAM) and the promotion of AI nudify apps, and we take active measures to prevent such content on our platforms... We have taken multiple steps to combat this, including bans, legal action against other advertisers, action against coordinated networks, and the removal of 92 million sexual ads. We are also actively exploring ways to further improve our detection capabilities." Apple spokesperson Peter Ajemian said TTP's report does not reflect Apple's current software and safety features; Apple's added protections include stronger safeguards for minors and expanded parental controls in Screen Time so families can block children and teens from downloading apps rated above their age. The senators' letter said AI-generated non-consensual nude images have increased over the past two years, a trend corroborated by multiple investigations. A UNICEF report published in early 2026 found that at least 1.2 million children across 11 countries reported being victims of non-consensual nude imagery. In October, after TTP researchers contacted Apple about AI nudify apps they found in the App Store, Apple provided further clarification of its policies. Google previously told The Guardian it proactively detects and removes apps with harmful content, and Meta launched a new AI tool specifically to identify and remove ads containing CSAM. The senators wrote that these findings show Apple and Google have not only failed to remove apps that facilitate intimate-image abuse but may also profit from distributing them.
items.why_zh: 推测：这显示AI生成未经同意的私密影像正成为平台治理与立法压力的焦点，但信中指控与公司回应尚属各执一词，摘要未提供独立核实。

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，据英国《卫报》报道，美国参议员罗恩 · 怀登、埃德 · 马基和本 · 卢汉指出，苹果和谷歌未能有效识别或下架用于生成未经当事人同意的裸照或色情图像的应用。 三人还指出，Meta 仍在从这些所谓的 AI 脱衣应用广告中获利。 当地时间 18 日，三人向苹果、谷歌和 Meta 的 CEO 致函，指出各公司现有的防护措施 不足以阻止 AI 脱衣应用出现在各自的应用商店或平台上 。 研究发现，苹果、谷歌和 Meta 的政策均禁止此类应用，它们却仍然出现在苹果和谷歌应用商店中，或通过 Meta 平台上的广告推广。研究还发现，儿童依然能够轻易接触到这些应用。 来自俄勒冈州的参议员怀登指出，如果这些公司不加强打击那些专门为造成伤害而设计并推广的应用，国会就需要采取行动。“AI 大幅提升了制作和传播未经当事人同意的色情影像的能力，给女性和女孩造成了巨大伤害。大型科技公司没有增加应对这一挑战的投入，反而在削减负责保护用户免受伤害的团队。我希望弄清楚，为什么 Meta、苹果和谷歌会漏掉那些明显违反自身规则的行为。” 谷歌发言人卡尔 · 瑞安在声明中回应称：“Google Play 不允许含有色情内容或允许用户对他人图像进行 AI 脱衣处理的应用上架。我们一直主动采取措施，检测并下架含有有害内容的应用。” Meta 发言人安迪 · 斯通在声明中回应称：“我们禁止传播儿童性虐待材料（CSAM），也禁止推广 AI 脱衣应用，并积极采取措施，防止此类内容出现在我们的平台上。…… 我们已经采取多项措施打击这些行为，包括封禁、对其他广告商采取法律行动、打击协同行动网络，以及 删除 9200 万条色情广告 。我们也在积极探索进一步改进检测能力的方法。” 苹果发言人彼得 · 阿杰米安表示，TTP 的报告并未反映苹果现行的软件及安全功能。苹果新增的保护措施包括加强对青少年的保护，以及在“屏幕使用时间”中扩展家长控制功能，让家庭能够阻止儿童和青少年下载年龄分级超出其年龄范围的应用。 IT之家从报道中获悉，参议员们在信中指出，过去两年， 未经当事人同意而由 AI 生成的裸照数量有所增加 。这一趋势也在多项调查得到印证。联合国儿童基金会在 2026 年初发布的报告显示，11 个国家至少有 120 万名儿童报告称，自己曾遭遇未经本人同意的裸照侵害。 10 月，TTP 研究人员就他们在苹果 App Store 发现的 AI 脱衣应用联系苹果后，苹果对自身政策作出了进一步说明。谷歌此前向《卫报》表示，公司会主动检测并下架含有有害内容的应用。Meta 则推出了新的 AI 工具，专门用于识别和删除含有 CSAM 的广告。 参议员们在信中写道，这些发现表明，苹果和谷歌不仅没有下架助长私密影像侵害的应用，还可能从这些应用的分发过程中获利。

items.title_zh: 代码显示三星正为 One UI 9.5 开发 AI 智能天气提醒功能：可根据用户作息与通勤时间推送通知
items.title_en: Code suggests Samsung is developing AI smart weather alerts for One UI 9.5, timed to users' routines and commutes
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，外媒 SammyGuru 在拆解三星最新 One UI 9.5 测试版时，发现三星正在为天气应用测试多项 AI 智能提醒功能，系统能够识别用户的起床时间和通勤行为，在用户起床、上班或下班回家时自动加载最新天气信息。 具体来看，相应功能依赖三星 Personal Data Intelligence（个人数据智能）系统，能够识别用户早晨何时起床、何时开始通勤，当系统检测到用户离开家或工作地点时，天气应用便会向用户自动弹出天气预报卡片。 在隐私方面，相应代码字符串显示 Personal Data Intelligence 会在用户设备本地分析位置数据，但用户的经纬度信息仍会分享给三星天气数据服务提供商 The Weather Channel，该服务商只会将位置数据用于提供天气信息，不会与第三方分享。 除了天气应用，三星还计划让 One UI 9.5 中的其他功能了解用户的日常通勤习惯。外媒 Android Authority 此前发现，三星为新版系统悄悄新增一项“三星驾驶报告（Driving Report）”功能，该功能能够在用户驾车出行前提前检查天气状况和睡眠评分，并在用户出发时间前约 1 小时推送相关提醒。 结合本次天气应用新增的通勤天气预测功能来看，三星似乎希望通过 One UI 9.5 更全面地学习用户的日常作息和出行规律，从而提供更加主动的个性化服务，预计这些功能将于明年年初 Galaxy S27 系列发布时在 One UI 9.5 正式版上线。
items.summary_en: Foreign outlet SammyGuru said that while examining Samsung's latest One UI 9.5 beta, it found Samsung is testing multiple AI smart reminder features for its weather app, with the system able to recognize users' wake-up times and commuting behavior and automatically load the latest weather information when users wake up, go to work or head home. The features rely on Samsung's Personal Data Intelligence system, which can identify when a user wakes up in the morning and when they start commuting; when the system detects the user leaving home or the workplace, the weather app automatically pops up a forecast card. On privacy, code strings indicate Personal Data Intelligence analyzes location data locally on the device, but the user's latitude and longitude are still shared with Samsung weather data provider The Weather Channel, which uses the location data only to provide weather information and does not share it with third parties. Beyond the weather app, Samsung also plans to let other One UI 9.5 features learn users' daily commuting habits. Android Authority previously found that Samsung quietly added a "Driving Report" feature to the new system, which can check weather conditions and sleep scores before a user drives and push a reminder about an hour before departure. Combined with the new commute-based weather prediction, Samsung appears to want One UI 9.5 to learn users' daily routines and travel patterns more comprehensively to offer more proactive personalized services; the features are expected to launch in the official One UI 9.5 with the Galaxy S27 series early next year.
items.why_zh: 推测：若落地，这类基于行为预测的主动提醒把个性化与隐私权衡推到前台，但当前仅为测试版代码线索，功能与上线时间未获官方确认。
items.why_en: Speculative: if shipped, such behavior-predicting proactive alerts would foreground the trade-off between personalization and privacy, but these are only beta code clues and neither the features nor the launch timing have been officially confirmed.

items.title_zh: “大空头”迈克尔 · 伯里谈 AI 股暴跌：我早就提醒过你们了
items.title_en: "Big Short" Michael Burry on the AI stock selloff: I warned you
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，“大空头”迈克尔 · 伯里在 X 平台发文称：“CoreWeave、Nebius、英伟达，还有半导体股，我都试着提醒过大家。我没让你们做空，但我提供的信息 足以让你们决定卖出股票 。” 当地时间 20 日开盘，英伟达股价下跌约 4%（最高跌幅达 14%），CoreWeave 和 Nebius 的跌幅均在 7% 左右。 据《商业内幕》报道，自 10 月 6 日触及盘中高点以来，英伟达、CoreWeave 和 Nebius 的股价分别下跌约 42%、55% 和 65%。本轮 AI 股回调始于 10 月 7 日，同期纽约证券交易所半导体指数累计下跌约 30%。 11 月 11 日，黄仁勋辞去英伟达 CEO 职务的前一天，伯里在 Substack 发文 呼吁股东卖出英伟达股票 。他预测，随着频频促成交易的黄仁勋离任，英伟达的 增长将放缓，利润率也将收窄 。 11 月 12 日，伯里又将警告范围扩大到 Nebius 和 CoreWeave 等英伟达合作伙伴。此类企业被称为“新型云服务商 / 新云服务商”， 主要通过建设数据中心，向客户出租英伟达芯片及其他 AI 基础设施的使用权 。 伯里指出，英伟达的市场影响力和慷慨扶持让这些企业受益匪浅，但这种局面似乎发生了根本变化。 早在 8 月 12 日，伯里就曾断言：“Nebius 就是繁荣行情见顶的写照。” Nebius 当天的收盘价为 259 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1,733 元人民币） ，比 11 月 19 日的收盘价高出 62%。 再往前一周，伯里 8 月 6 日称自己 忍不住想做空 Nebius 和甲骨文 ，认为做空两家公司简直易如反掌。今年，他还做空过英伟达、CoreWeave 及半导体指数。 伯里一年前不再经营对冲基金，转而通过 Substack 分享个人投资观点。此后，他始终对 AI 股票的暴涨持公开怀疑态度。 作为一名逆向投资者，伯里曾是少数 成功预见 2008 年房地产泡沫破裂并从中获利 的人之一。他一直警告，AI 企业对芯片、数据中心等折旧迅速的资产投入过多资金。 伯里还批评 AI 企业采用激进的会计处理手法、开展循环融资交易，并背负着危险规模的债务和表外负债。 此次，伯里再次在 X 平台强调，他对英伟达及其合作伙伴和同行的担忧远不止黄仁勋涉嫌婚外情，以及民主党控制参众两院后可能出现的对 AI 行业不利的政治环境。“如果你还觉得这一切只是婚外情和政治问题，那就说明你 想得还不够深 。”
items.summary_en: "Big Short" investor Michael Burry wrote on X: "CoreWeave, Nebius, Nvidia, and semis — I tried to warn you. I didn't tell you to short, but the information I provided was enough for you to decide to sell." At the open on the 20th local time, Nvidia shares fell about 4% (with a maximum drop of 14%), while CoreWeave and Nebius each fell about 7%. According to Business Insider, since hitting intraday highs on Oct. 6, Nvidia, CoreWeave and Nebius shares are down about 42%, 55% and 65% respectively. The AI stock pullback began on Oct. 7, and the NYSE Semiconductor Index has fallen about 30% over the same period. On Nov. 11, the day before Jensen Huang stepped down as Nvidia CEO, Burry published a Substack post urging shareholders to sell Nvidia, predicting that growth would slow and margins would narrow after Huang, who frequently brokered deals, departed. On Nov. 12, Burry widened his warning to Nvidia partners such as Nebius and CoreWeave. These companies, called "neoclouds," mainly build data centers and rent out access to Nvidia chips and other AI infrastructure. Burry said Nvidia's market influence and generous support benefited these firms, but that situation appears to have fundamentally changed. As early as Aug. 12, Burry declared: "Nebius is the picture of a boom topping out." Nebius closed that day at $259, 62% above its Nov. 19 close. A week earlier, on Aug. 6, Burry said he could hardly resist shorting Nebius and Oracle, calling shorting both companies easy. This year he also shorted Nvidia, CoreWeave and the semiconductor index. Burry stopped running a hedge fund a year ago and now shares his investment views on Substack; since then he has been openly skeptical of the AI stock surge. A contrarian investor, Burry was among the few who foresaw and profited from the 2008 housing bubble bust. He has warned that AI companies are investing too much in rapidly depreciating assets such as chips and data centers. Burry has also criticized AI companies for aggressive accounting, circular financing deals, and dangerous levels of debt and off-balance-sheet liabilities. On X this time, Burry stressed that his concerns about Nvidia, its partners and peers go far beyond Huang's alleged extramarital affair and the potentially unfavorable political environment for AI if Democrats control both chambers of Congress. "If you still think this is just an affair and politics, you're not thinking deeply enough."
items.why_zh: 推测：伯里的公开质疑可能放大市场对AI资本开支与会计质量的担忧，但其观点属个人押注，摘要未提供其业绩或数据核验。

items.title_zh: 韩国高考 AI 作弊事件发酵，教育部长引咎辞职
items.title_en: South Korea College Entrance Exam AI Cheating Scandal Escalates; Education Minister Resigns
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 22 日消息，据韩联社报道，当地时间 22 日，韩国教育部长官崔教振辞去职务，为韩国 2027 年度大学修学能力考试（韩国高考）期间防范高科技作弊措施不足引发混乱而承担责任。 近期，韩国发生多起利用人工智能工具作弊事件，引发民众广泛担忧。针对在考试前几天反复修改使用人工智能（AI）作弊的指导方针被不断修改，导致考生和教育界陷入“混乱”，这一批评进一步加剧。李在明 20 日在总统府青瓦台召开会议，呼吁对高考制度进行全面改革，应对人工智能快速发展下，各类新型作弊手段给考试公平带来的挑战。 IT之家注意到，韩国高考明确禁止考生携带任何电子设备进入考场，尤其是出现在近期多起作弊丑闻的人工智能（AI）眼镜。指南显示，禁带物品包括手机、平板电脑、AI 眼镜、智能手表、具备蓝牙通信功能的耳机等。 每个考点将安排一名工作人员专门检查 AI 眼镜 ，考生若佩戴 AI 眼镜，即使没有使用，也将被取消当年考试成绩和下一年度报考资格。 然而，在韩国教育部的大力管控下，仍然查处了 111 名违规携带智能设备的考生。据韩国教育部此前介绍，通过发送应急公益短信查出 54 起未上交手机 的案例；通过探测 WiFi 等方式查出 52 起携带智能设备案例。在考试过程中被发现利用智能终端的作弊案例 5 起，包括使用智能眼镜（1 起）、使用微型摄像头和无线耳机（1 起）、利用智能手机拍摄考卷（1 起），以及在洗手间使用智能手机（2 起）。 韩国教育部此前还表示，111 名作弊考生均属于与智能终端相关的违规人员，至于与智能终端无关的一般作弊行为，譬如违反考试时间规定等情况，未被计入本次统计。教育部正对作弊者携带的物品和作弊类型进行进一步分析， 并计划在 12 月 11 日高考成绩公布前完成相关处置工作 。
items.summary_en: According to Yonhap, on the 22nd local time, South Korean Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin resigned to take responsibility for the confusion caused by insufficient measures against high-tech cheating during the 2027 College Scholastic Ability Test (South Korea's college entrance exam). Recently, multiple cases of cheating using AI tools have raised widespread concern; criticism intensified because guidelines on AI cheating were repeatedly revised in the days before the exam, throwing test-takers and the education sector into confusion. Lee Jae-myung convened a meeting at the presidential office in Cheong Wa Dae on the 20th and called for comprehensive reform of the exam system to address the challenge that new cheating methods pose to exam fairness amid rapid AI development. South Korea's exam explicitly bans electronic devices including phones, tablets, AI glasses, smartwatches and Bluetooth earphones; each test site assigns one staff member specifically to check AI glasses, and a test-taker wearing AI glasses, even without using them, will have that year's score cancelled and be barred from applying the following year. Despite these controls, 111 test-takers were caught violating rules on carrying smart devices: 54 cases of failing to hand in phones were found via emergency public-service text messages, 52 cases of carrying smart devices were found by detecting Wi-Fi and other means, and 5 cheating cases using smart terminals were found during the exam, including AI glasses (1), a miniature camera and wireless earphones (1), photographing the exam paper with a smartphone (1), and using a smartphone in the restroom (2). The ministry said all 111 were violations related to smart terminals and that general cheating unrelated to smart terminals, such as violating exam time rules, was not included; it is further analyzing the items carried and types of cheating and plans to complete handling before scores are announced on Dec 11.
items.why_zh: AI 眼镜等新型设备对高风险考试公平构成现实压力；辞职显示治理问责，但新规效果仍待观察（推测）。
items.why_en: It shows AI glasses and similar devices are putting real pressure on fairness in high-stakes exams; the resignation signals governance pressure, but the effect of new rules remains to be seen (speculative).

items.title_zh: 群联展示内置 NPU 与 64GB 内存的智能固态硬盘，可直接运行 AI 模型
items.title_en: Phison shows smart SSD with built-in NPU and 64GB memory that can run AI models directly
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 22 日消息，据科技媒体 Tom's Hardware 昨天报道，群联在 SC26 大会中展示两款企业级固态硬盘，专为 AI 场景设计。其中一款甚至带有 NPU 和 64GB 内存，可以直接运行 AI 模型。 IT之家从原报道获悉， 其中一款产品 SSD 内置 NPU（神经网络引擎） 、 64GB 内存 ，带宽达到 130GB/s，支持直接在硬盘上运行 PyTorch、vLLM、OpenVINO 和 llama.cpp 等 AI 框架及推理工具。 该产品的设计思路是将部分计算任务从服务器转移至 SSD，让设备直接处理存储的数据，仅向主机返回结果，无需完整传输数据集。 群联表示，该方案在特定工作负载下有望将数据传输量减少 10 至 100 倍，从而降低主机 CPU 的负载。 另一款产品采用全新的 Mixed Media 混合介质设计，将高耐久性的 pSLC 缓存与大容量 QLC 闪存整合在同一块 SSD 中，并通过一颗 16 通道主控进行管理。 该方案将部分 QLC 闪存切换至 SLC 工作模式，以牺牲部分存储容量为代价，提升写入性能和耐久性。两个存储区域分别分配独立命名空间，主机可以根据数据类型选择对应的存储区域，无需额外安装专用软件。 群联称这种方案能够减少独立缓存盘的依赖。在包含 24 块 SSD 的系统中，如果其中一块硬盘发生故障，缓存损失比例仅为 4%，而采用 4 块独立缓存盘的传统方案可能损失 25% 的缓存容量。
items.summary_en: According to tech media Tom's Hardware, Phison at the SC26 conference showed two enterprise SSDs designed for AI scenarios, one of which has a built-in NPU and 64GB of memory and can run AI models directly. The product has an integrated NPU (neural processing unit), 64GB of memory and 130GB/s bandwidth, and supports running AI frameworks and inference tools such as PyTorch, vLLM, OpenVINO and llama.cpp directly on the drive. Its design shifts some computing tasks from the server to the SSD, letting the device process stored data directly and return only results to the host without transferring the full dataset. Phison said the approach could reduce data transfer by 10 to 100 times under certain workloads, lowering host CPU load. Another product uses a new Mixed Media design that combines high-endurance pSLC cache with large-capacity QLC flash in a single SSD managed by a 16-channel controller. The approach switches part of the QLC flash to SLC mode, sacrificing some storage capacity to improve write performance and endurance. The two storage areas are assigned independent namespaces, and the host can choose the corresponding area based on data type without installing special software. Phison said this reduces reliance on separate cache drives; in a system with 24 SSDs, if one drive fails, cache loss is only 4%, while a traditional scheme with four separate cache drives could lose 25% of cache capacity.
items.why_zh: 推测：把推理能力下沉到存储设备，可能改变AI服务器的数据搬运方式和能效瓶颈。
items.why_en: Speculative: moving inference capability down to storage devices could change data movement and energy-efficiency bottlenecks in AI servers.

items.title_zh: TikTok 上线 AI 深度伪造检测工具，为创造者推出“肖像检测”功能
items.title_en: TikTok launches AI deepfake detection tool and 'portrait detection' feature for creators
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 22 日消息，当地时间 11 月 19 日，TikTok 宣布推出两项新工具，进一步推进人工智能透明度建设，让社区用户在 TikTok 上创作和接触人工智能内容时，拥有更高的知情度与掌控力。 TikTok 推出了一款新的 透明度工具 ，让任何人都能自主进行核验。即便没有 TikTok 账号，用户也可以上传图片或视频，检测其是否由 TikTok 的人工智能创作功能生成或编辑。除了内容凭证外，该工具还会检测 TikTok 专有的隐形水印 VeraDura—— 该水印持久性更强，也更难以被去除。 此外，TikTok 将面向全球逐步推出“肖像检测”功能。这项需用户主动开启的工具，能够帮助符合条件的 创作者在 TikTok 上发现并标记可能未经授权使用其肖像的人工智能生成内容 。 IT之家从官方新闻稿获悉，迄今为止，TikTok 已为平台上超过 50 亿条 AI 生成视频添加标识；违规 AI 内容中超过 99% 在被用户举报前即被平台主动移除。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 22: on local time Nov 19, TikTok announced two new tools to further advance AI transparency, giving community users greater awareness and control when creating and encountering AI content on TikTok. TikTok introduced a new transparency tool that lets anyone verify content independently. Even users without a TikTok account can upload an image or video to check whether it was generated or edited by TikTok's AI creation features. In addition to content credentials, the tool also detects TikTok's proprietary invisible watermark VeraDura, which is more persistent and harder to remove. In addition, TikTok will gradually roll out a "portrait detection" feature globally. This opt-in tool helps eligible creators find and flag AI-generated content on TikTok that may use their likeness without authorization. According to the official press release, TikTok has so far labeled more than 5 billion AI-generated videos on the platform, and more than 99% of violating AI content was proactively removed by the platform before being reported by users.
items.why_zh: 推测：平台自建 AI 内容检测与肖像保护工具，可能推动 AI 生成内容在社交平台上的可追溯性与标识标准提高。
items.why_en: Speculation: platform-built AI content detection and likeness-protection tools could push social platforms toward higher traceability and labeling standards for AI-generated content.

items.title_zh: Anthropic能否承担“安全优先”的代价？
items.title_en: Can Anthropic afford to put safety first?
items.summary_zh: 这是“AI在现实生活”系列第三集、也是最后一集，主持人与The Verge资深AI记者Hayden Field讨论Anthropic的IPO。文中称，Claude背后的AI实验室上周四在纳斯达克上市；数字巨大，但对本次对话并不那么重要，只说明Anthropic已成为全球市值最高的公司之一。真正的问题在于接下来会发生什么，以及Anthropic能否在成为需对股东负责的上市公司的同时，继续兼顾并投资AI安全；此外它还要持续增长收入，以支付不断上升的算力账单——文中称未来几年合计约9000亿美元。Hayden与主持人试图分析，在Anthropic应对公开市场压力的过程中，这可能如何演变。节目还谈到该公司独特的公司治理结构（在“Jensen Huang”事件持续发酵的背景下尤显相关）、为何OpenAI似乎乐见Anthropic先上市，以及Anthropic面向大客户的整体卖点为何归结为同一套安全品牌——而这套品牌如今与其盈利导向的业务部分存在冲突。节目最后请听众订阅YouTube上的Decoder。
items.summary_en: Today, I’m talking with Hayden Field, The Verge ’s senior AI reporter, about the Anthropic IPO for the third and final episode in our series about AI in real life. The AI lab behind Claude went public on the Nasdaq last Thursday. The numbers are gigantic, but not really that important for this conversation, except to say that Anthropic has become one of the most valuable companies on the planet. The real story is what happens now — and whether Anthropic can continue to thread the needle of caring about and investing in AI safety while also being a public company beholden to shareholders. Oh, and it also continuously growing the amount of money it makes so it can keep paying its ever-increasing compute bills, which total roughly $900 billion over the coming years. All of these ideas sit in a fascinating tension with one another, and so Hayden and I really tried to break down how we think this might play out as Anthropic navigates the pressures of the public markets. You’ll hear us talk about the company’s unique corporate governance structure , something that is especially relevant in the wake of the ongoing Jensen Huang saga. We also get into why OpenAI seems happy to have let Anthropic go public first , and why Anthropic’s whole pitch to big customers boils down to the same safety branding that now sits in conflict with the profit-oriented part of its business. Before we get going, do me a favor and subscribe to Decoder on YouTube, where we put out new episodes every Monday and Thursday. items.why_zh: 推测：这触及前沿AI公司“安全品牌”与上市公司盈利压力之间的结构性张力，但节目为观点讨论，摘要中的数字与说法未获独立核验。
items.why_en: Speculative: this touches on the structural tension between frontier AI companies' safety branding and the profit pressures of being public, but the episode is a discussion of views and the figures and claims in the summary are not independently verified.

items.title_en: South Korea's President Lee Jae-myung: speed is crucial in the AI race
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，据路透社报道，当地时间 21 日，韩国总统李在明前往韩国东南部城市蔚山，视察当地一座在建数据中心，并敦促韩国加快在全球 AI 竞赛中的步伐。“ 全世界都在竞相角逐，速度至关重要 。” 数据中心是芯片需求的重要来源。李在明希望，SK 建设的蔚山项目能够取得成功，进而吸引全球 AI 企业加大投资。 蔚山数据中心由 SK 集团与亚马逊云科技共同开发。韩国科学技术信息通信部去年公布的估算显示，项目到 2029 年的总投资额预计为 7 万亿韩元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 351.26 亿元人民币） ，计划于 2027 年下半年投入运营。 SK 集团会长崔泰源 9 月介绍，在建数据中心首期容量 预计到 2029 年达到 103MW ，未来还计划在此基础上 扩容近 900MW 。随着项目推进，SK 也计划与全球科技公司建立更多合作。 李在明指出，AI 投资此前主要集中在首尔一带，蔚山项目则说明其他地区同样具备增长空间。得知现场约有 900 人参与施工后，他还提到，高端设施建设面临建筑工人短缺，各部委需要考虑如何培养建设数据中心和 AI 基础设施所需的工人。
items.summary_en: According to Reuters, on the 21st local time, South Korean President Lee Jae-myung visited a data center under construction in the southeastern city of Ulsan and urged South Korea to speed up in the global AI race. "The whole world is competing, and speed is crucial," he said. Data centers are a major source of chip demand. Lee hopes the SK-built Ulsan project will succeed and attract more investment from global AI companies. The Ulsan data center is being developed by SK Group and Amazon Web Services. Estimates published last year by South Korea's Ministry of Science and ICT put total investment in the project through 2029 at 7 trillion won, with operations planned to begin in the second half of 2027. SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won said in September that the first phase of the data center is expected to reach 103MW by 2029, with plans to add nearly 900MW on top of that. As the project advances, SK also plans more partnerships with global tech companies. Lee noted that AI investment had previously been concentrated around Seoul, and the Ulsan project shows other regions also have room to grow. After learning that about 900 people were working on the site, he also said high-end facility construction faces a shortage of construction workers and that ministries need to consider how to train the workers needed to build data centers and AI infrastructure.
items.why_zh: 推测：这显示各国政府把数据中心与算力基础设施视为AI竞赛的抓手，但项目进度与投资规模仍取决于企业与市场，摘要未提供最新确认。
items.why_en: Speculative: this shows governments treating data centers and compute infrastructure as levers in the AI race, but project timelines and investment scale still depend on companies and markets, and the summary offers no fresh confirmation.

items.title_en: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US

items.title_zh: The most misunderstood graph in AI just got a major update
items.title_en: The most misunderstood graph in AI just got a major update
items.summary_zh: The most misunderstood graph in AI just got a major update MIT Technology Review
items.summary_en: A new report from the AI evaluation nonprofit METR finds that some AI capabilities are continuing to improve along an exponential trajectory—but it also indicates that models aren’t quite as good at tasks that require judgment as they are at coding. The report is an update to the organization’s time horizon plot, which was widely shared— and widely misinterpreted , owing to the complexity of the measures it used. METR evaluated models by having them attempt a large suite of tasks, each of which had also been completed by humans. Each task’s difficulty was scored by how long it took the human testers to finish it—and then models were rated according to the length of the tasks that they could complete. That plot showed that AI systems were rapidly improving—every four months, the length of the tasks that frontier models could successfully complete doubled. The updated plot adds more tasks—some that are estimated to take humans far longer than those in the original suite, and others that are more open-ended. One of the biggest questions in AI right now is the extent to which progress on “verifiable” tasks—where it’s possible to check automatically whether an AI system has succeeded or failed—carry over into tasks on which success or failure is harder to measure. We know how to teach neural networks how to do verifiable tasks: Researchers have the systems attempt one many times, strengthen the neural pathways that contribute to success, and weaken the pathways that contribute to failures. That’s why AI systems have become so good at coding and math, two domains where it’s possible to determine automatically whether a solution does or doesn’t work. items.why_zh: 推测：如果可验证任务上的进步难以迁移到开放式判断任务，这张图表的“每四个月翻倍”趋势可能高估模型的实际可用能力。
items.why_en: Speculative: if gains on verifiable tasks do not transfer well to open-ended judgment tasks, the plot's four-month doubling trend may overstate models' practically usable capability.

items.title_en: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved prestigious Millennium Prize problem with Claude
items.summary_zh: 报道称，Anthropic 数学家 Levent Alpöge 声称在 Claude 的帮助下证明了黎曼猜想——数学界最著名的难题之一，这一难题数十年来一直困扰着世界顶尖数学家。若获验证，这将是 AI 在数学领域的又一重大成果，也会加剧此前 OpenAI 在该领域（往往并不优雅的）尝试所引发的震荡。报道指出，Alpöge 的解法尚未经过独立验证，Anthropic 未就此发表评论，也未介入 Alpöge 的声明。在个人网站上的一份文件中，Alpöge 称他曾就此事给 Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 发短信。全文见 The Verge。

Alpöge's solution has yet to be verified independently. Anthropic has not commented or involved itself in Alpöge's announcement. items.why_zh: 推测：这是尚未经独立验证的个人声明，其意义在于凸显 AI 辅助数学证明中的可信度与验证机制问题，而不宜当作已确认的突破。
items.why_en: Speculative: this is an unverified personal claim whose significance lies in highlighting credibility and verification issues for AI-assisted mathematical proof, and it should not be treated as a confirmed breakthrough.

items.title_en: Signal is blocking Gemini and Siri AI from reading your screen
items.summary_zh: Signal 正在限制 Android 与 iOS 设备上的截屏能力，以阻止 AI 智能体读取用户消息和其他数据。Signal 总裁 Meredith Whittaker 在博客文章中表示，操作系统内置的、通过分析屏幕信息来更多了解用户的智能体式 AI 能力“正在削弱 Signal 独立保障隐私的能力”，并呼吁操作系统提供方让应用开发者更容易控制智能体可访问的数据。她说：“我们想说得非常清楚：Signal 以及其他应用开发者缺乏有力工具来阻止 AI 智能体（读取数据），这是一个严重问题。”

items.why_zh: 推测：这暴露出端侧 AI 智能体与端到端加密应用之间的权限冲突，可能推动操作系统层面针对 AI 智能体数据访问的规则制定。
items.why_en: Speculative: this exposes a permissions conflict between on-device AI agents and end-to-end encrypted apps, and may push toward OS-level rules governing agent data access.
